name.en: Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages

languageRequirements.minimum: Level4, total score180 or above; valid CSCA results are separately required.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-taught undergraduate route; HSK4≥180 is the application threshold.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课本科项目；申请须达到HSK4级总分180分。

eligibility.en: High-school graduation or an equivalent/higher qualification; non-Chinese citizenship with a foreign ordinary passport.
eligibility.zh: 具有高中毕业或同等以上学历，持外国普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Age18–55. Applicants under18 require university consent, a notarized guardianship document and other required legal documents.
eligibility.zh: 年龄18–55岁；未满18周岁须经学校同意，并提供监护人公证书等相关文件。

eligibility.en: Two groups must meet the additional nationality/residence requirements: (1) applicants born with foreign nationality and without Chinese nationality whose parent(s), one or both Chinese citizens, had settled abroad; (2) former residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan who emigrated and acquired foreign nationality. They must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years and have actually resided abroad for at least 2 years within the last 4 years, counted up to April 30 of the admission year. At least 9 months of actual residence abroad in a year counts as one year, based on entry/exit stamps.
eligibility.zh: 以下两类申请人须满足额外国籍与居住要求：①父母双方或一方为中国公民并定居外国、本人出生时即具有外国国籍且不具有中国国籍者；②祖国大陆（内地）、香港、澳门和台湾居民移民并获得外国国籍后，以国际学生身份申请本科者。须持有有效外国护照或国籍证明文件4年（含）以上，且最近4年（截至入学年度4月30日前）内在外国实际居住2年以上；一年中实际境外居住满9个月可按一年计算，以入境和出境签章为准。

eligibility.en: HSK4 with a total score of180 or above; valid CSCA results are required for all undergraduate applicants from autumn2026 onward.
eligibility.zh: HSK4级总分180分及以上；自2026年秋季起，所有本科申请人须提交有效CSCA成绩。

applicationMaterials.en: Passport information page; high-school diploma and complete transcripts for every term, with notarized Chinese/English translations where needed. Prospective graduates submit an original pre-graduation certificate and must provide the final diploma before enrollment.
applicationMaterials.zh: 护照信息页；高中学历证明及所有学期完整成绩单，必要时提供中文或英文公证翻译件。应届生须提交预毕业证明原件，并于入学前补交正式毕业证。

applicationMaterials.en: HSK certificate; valid CSCA results; a signed recommendation letter in Chinese/English with the recommender’s contact details.
applicationMaterials.zh: HSK等级证书、有效CSCA成绩；中文或英文推荐信，推荐人亲笔签名并附有效联系方式。

applicationMaterials.en: Pay the CNY800 application fee through the official online system. The 2027 catalogue states that it cannot be refunded for reasons not attributable to the university. Provide a guarantor’s valid ID and, for a foreign guarantor in China, a valid Chinese visa.
applicationMaterials.zh: 通过官方报名系统线上支付800元报名费；2027目录注明“非校方原因无法退还”。提交担保人有效证件，在华外籍担保人另需有效在华签证。

applicationMaterials.en: Personal ID photo, a non-criminal-record certificate, and any further materials required by the chosen programme.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人证件照、无犯罪记录，以及所报专业另行要求的其他材料。

campus.en: Years1–2: Hainan/Beijing as assigned by the published university training arrangement; years3–4: Beijing.
campus.zh: 第1–2年依学校公布的培养安排在海南/北京就读，第3–4年在北京就读。

tuitionSchedule.en: Beijing: CNY25,800 per academic year; Hainan: CNY22,000 per academic year. Years1–2 take place at Hainan or Beijing according to the university-assigned training arrangement; years3–4 take place in Beijing. The numeric fee is the Beijing rate, not a universal campus price.
tuitionSchedule.zh: 北京校区每学年25800元，海南校区每学年22000元。第1–2年按学校公布的培养安排在海南或北京就读，第3–4年在北京就读；数值学费为北京标准，并非所有校区统一价格。

notes.en: Spring2027 entry is explicitly listed in the newly published2027 undergraduate catalogue; application deadline1February2027. Specific opening/registration dates follow the admission notice. Fees depend on assigned campus: Beijing25800/year; Hainan22000/year, with years3–4 in Beijing. The live general entry page still shows closed2026 dates; those dates are not reused. Its general eligibility/material rules are used because the2027 catalogue expressly refers applicants to the website/application guide. No scholarship award or campus choice is promised.
notes.zh: 新发布2027本科目录明确每年3月/9月入学，春季报名截止2027年2月1日，具体开学/报到日期以录取通知为准。学费按实际安排校区区分：北京25800元/学年、海南22000元/学年，第3–4年在北京。现行入学资格页仍保留已关闭的2026报名日期，本记录不沿用这些旧日期；2027目录明确引导申请人参考官网/报名指南，故仅采用其通用资格和材料要求。不承诺奖学金或可自行选择校区。
